policy.notificationRule: notify only for a deduplicated candidate at or above the materiality threshold
policy.promotionRule: all production gates pass, license is admitted, maturity is released, and a receipt is sealed

releases.title: @huggingface/kernels + WebGPU kernel collection
releases.whyItMatters: Versioned browser GPU operators with correctness cases, benchmark cases, provenance, and WGSL templates create a credible local inference lane.
releases.operationalTarget: Benchmark selected operators against SZL reference paths on real browser/device classes before routing any workload.
releases.license: Apache-2.0 collection; verify selected artifact metadata
sourceClaims: Hugging Face announced 207 versioned WebGPU kernels.
Packages carry interfaces, correctness cases, benchmark cases, provenance, and WGSL templates.
Published operator speedups remain upstream evidence until reproduced on SZL hardware.

gates.title: Primary sources pinned
gates.evidence: Official Hugging Face release and kernel namespace recorded.

gates.title: Browser/device preflight
gates.evidence: Run adapter, dtype, shape, and fallback checks across the supported matrix.

gates.title: Reference-output parity
gates.evidence: Require deterministic parity across supported browsers, devices, dtypes, and edge cases.

gates.title: Measured end-to-end gain
gates.evidence: Require repeated p50/p95 improvement without memory or thermal regression.

gates.title: Fallback path verified
gates.evidence: Fallback runtime and device-loss recovery must be exercised before promotion.

releases.title: NeoMME multimodal-native multilingual encoders
releases.whyItMatters: A single bidirectional multimodal encoder can emit dense and late-interaction representations for page-image retrieval, reducing separate vision/text towers and improving visual RAG economics.
releases.operationalTarget: Shadow-evaluate 260M Retriever on SZL document/page-image corpora against the current text-only and multimodal baselines.
sourceClaims: NeoMME ships 260M and 800M multilingual multimodal encoders.
Retriever variants emit dense and late-interaction embeddings in one forward pass.
Upstream throughput and compression claims require SZL reproduction on pinned corpora and hardware.

gates.title: Model and article pinned
gates.evidence: Official model and release article recorded.

gates.title: Pinned document benchmark
gates.evidence: Build a checksum-pinned multilingual page-image query set with qrels.

gates.title: Retrieval quality improvement
gates.evidence: Require nDCG/Recall gain against current SZL retrieval baselines.

gates.title: Latency and index economics
gates.evidence: Measure encode throughput, index bytes, p50/p95 search latency, and cost.

gates.title: Text-only fallback verified
gates.evidence: Failure and unsupported-input paths must degrade safely to the current retriever.

releases.title: Funes user-owned coding-agent memory
releases.whyItMatters: Treating agent memory as a portable dataset aligns with Yachay/Second Brain goals: owned traces, queryable history, agent portability, and no mandatory hosted memory service.
releases.operationalTarget: Adopt the dataset-as-memory interchange pattern, not an unreviewed service dependency; export/import bounded sanitized traces behind the Memory Covenant.
sourceClaims: The design stores coding-agent memory as a dataset rather than a hosted service.
The pattern targets continuity across machines and coding agents.
SZL should absorb the interchange idea while preserving Memory Covenant identity, purpose, lifecycle, provenance, and receipts.

gates.title: Primary article pinned
gates.evidence: Hugging Face article recorded.

gates.title: Portable trace schema
gates.evidence: Define a bounded SZL trace interchange schema with source handles and tombstones.

gates.title: Secret and PII redaction
gates.evidence: No raw secrets, credentials, or private memory may enter a public dataset.

gates.title: Tenant/domain isolation
gates.evidence: Cross-tenant recall and mixed security domains remain fail-closed.

gates.title: Deletion/tombstone semantics
gates.evidence: Derived indexes must stop returning deleted memory immediately.

releases.title: Microsoft VibeVoice-ASR-Streaming 1.5B / 7B
releases.whyItMatters: Streaming speaker-attributed ASR with hotwords creates a practical voice/operator ingestion path for command rooms, meetings, and real-time agent interfaces.
releases.operationalTarget: Start with the 1.5B model in a no-action transcription sandbox; seal audio hash, diarization output, timestamps, confidence, model revision, and latency.
sourceClaims: The streaming release transcribes speaker identity and content jointly.
It supports custom hotwords and ten languages.
Transcription must remain evidence input, never action authority.

gates.title: Model card pinned
gates.evidence: Microsoft Hugging Face model source recorded.

gates.title: Pinned ASR benchmark
gates.evidence: Measure WER/CER, diarization error, hotword recall, and latency on SZL-shaped audio.

gates.title: Streaming stability
gates.evidence: Test long sessions, speaker churn, dropouts, silence, and backpressure.

gates.title: Audio retention policy
gates.evidence: Audio and transcripts require explicit sensitivity, retention, and deletion controls.

gates.title: No speech-to-action bypass
gates.evidence: Voice output remains proposal/evidence input behind A11oy policy and approval.

releases.title: Qdrant FineWeb-10B + Supernova retrieval benchmark
releases.whyItMatters: Internet-scale dense/sparse/hybrid retrieval with exact ground truth is a serious benchmark substrate beyond toy RAG tests.
releases.operationalTarget: Run bounded checksum-pinned shards first; capture recall, p50/p95/p99, ingestion cost, memory, and failure behavior before scale-up.
releases.license: ODC-BY-1.0 corpus; query assets require separate review
sourceClaims: FineWeb-10B provides roughly 10.07B dense and sparse vector records.
Exact top-1000 ground truth supports reproducible recall/latency evaluation.
Full-corpus execution is intentionally not an initial CI workload.

gates.title: Dataset and article pinned
gates.evidence: Qdrant/Hugging Face sources recorded.

gates.title: Bounded reproducible shard
gates.evidence: Create checksum-pinned data/query/qrels shards.

gates.title: Hybrid retrieval SLO
gates.evidence: Measure recall@10/@100, tail latency, throughput, filters, and degraded-node behavior.

gates.title: Scale economics
gates.evidence: Storage, network, build-time, and serving cost receipt required.

gates.title: Query rights cleared
gates.evidence: Do not assume every benchmark query asset is production-cleared.

releases.title: Puffin-World native 3D multimodal world model
releases.whyItMatters: Camera-aware understanding, RGB-D generation, multi-view synthesis, and 3D reconstruction can extend SZL spatial/digital-twin research.
releases.operationalTarget: Keep isolated; reproduce one static-scene camera/depth task with sealed checkpoint, environment, inputs, outputs, and license evidence.
sourceClaims: Puffin-World unifies native 3D world states and multimodal generation/understanding.
The published stack requires substantial GPU research resources.
No production authority is inferred from research-model outputs.

gates.title: Canonical sources pinned
gates.evidence: ACE Robotics model and Hugging Face article recorded.

gates.title: Research-plane isolation
gates.evidence: No production connector or action authority.

gates.title: Published task reproduced
gates.evidence: Seal code, checkpoint, CUDA image, inputs, outputs, and measured result.

gates.title: License cleared
gates.evidence: No commercial/production assumption from custom license.

gates.title: Physical limitations bounded
gates.evidence: Dynamic scenes and long-horizon physics remain outside proven envelope.

releases.title: IBM Granite time-series models in Confluent Cloud
releases.whyItMatters: Forecasting/anomaly inference inside the event stream maps directly to Lyte's ingest-to-outcome architecture.
releases.operationalTarget: Benchmark TTM locally against naive baselines, then replay prediction events through the A11oy evidence/approval path before managed streaming adoption.
releases.license: Apache-2.0 model; managed service terms separate
releases.resourceClass: local model plus managed streaming integration
sourceClaims: Granite TTM is a compact Apache-2.0 time-series model family.
The architecture places inference into stream processing and writes predictions back to event topics.
Managed early-access deployment is not treated as generally available production infrastructure.

gates.title: Sources pinned
gates.evidence: IBM/Hugging Face sources recorded.

gates.title: Local baseline cleared
gates.evidence: Measure MASE/MAE, latency, memory, missing data, and drift.

gates.title: Prediction replay linked
gates.evidence: Input offset, model revision, output topic, decision, and outcome must be receipt-linked.

gates.title: Drift and abstention
gates.evidence: Define backtest windows, thresholds, abstention, rollback, and escalation.

gates.title: Managed integration verified
gates.evidence: Entitlement, regions, limits, SLA, and failure modes must be witnessed.
